title: Choose the visual world for the NVD Watch scorecard (hand 2)
question: The roll assigned the Nutrition Facts Panel. Keep it, take the pick, take the passport alternate, adopt a declined challenger, take the category standard, or re-roll.

options.label: Nutrition Facts Panel
options.lineage: FDA Nutrition Facts label, 1994 rule, 2016 revision
options.thesis: The page is the NVD's nutrition label: a white panel, black rules in three weights, one giant number, and a right-hand '% of goal' column on every row, with definitions frozen in the footnote.
materials: heavy grotesque bold for the headline row
options.viewport: A centred white panel on a pale grey ground, the panel as wide as the reading column. Top row in the label's heaviest black: 'NVD Facts'. Beneath the hairline: 'Serving: 30 days ending Nov 7, 2026 · 17,070 CVEs (Rejected excluded)'. Then the 8px rule and the headline row at poster scale: 'CPE coverage 22.6%' set like 'Calories 230'. Below the 3px rule, the table: each metric a row with its value left and its '% of goal' right in bold: 'KEV CVEs enriched within 1 business day — 94% of goal', 'Median CVE to KEV listing 14 days', 'Not Scheduled 40.8%', 'NIST-sourced CVSS 2.7%', 'Re-check rule cost $270K–$510K — 68–128% of OIG offset'. The footnote under the last 8px rule: '* % of goal tells you how far the NVD is from the target NIST or the OIG published for that measure.' The primary action sits in the panel's own grammar: a black-filled row 'Copy citation' and an outlined 'Download the brief (PDF)'. The four-section nav runs as a thin header above the panel. Section 2 begins below as a second panel.
options.risk: The joke lands once; the build has to carry four sections and a simulator in the same rule grammar without becoming a parody. Pure black on white can read as a mockup if the rule weights are not exact.

raised.raise: State vocabulary fixed by law: every status and metric state has one published treatment, and the page never invents a new one mid-section.
Uncertainty written as line weight: crude or censored figures carry a lighter rule and a labelled range, never the headline weight.
Static plate for every motion: the simulator and any animated figure have a resting state that prints and reads without JavaScript.
The labor beneath the spectacle: each cost figure shows the analyst-hours and the capacity share that produce it, in the same row.
One horizon: all four panels share one left edge and one right-aligned percent column, so the eye never re-learns the grid.
Printable, permalinked record: each panel prints as one page and each row has a stable URL, so a citation points at one line.

options.label: CBO Cost Estimate
options.lineage: Congressional Budget Office cost estimate ('the score') for a bill
options.thesis: The scorecard as the document Congress already calls a score: a plain serif memo with a summary box, a by-year effects table, and a basis-of-estimate section that shows the arithmetic.
options.viewport: A memo header: 'NVD Watch · Cost estimate · Re-check rule for Not Scheduled CVEs · November 7, 2026'. A boxed summary with the 22.6% coverage figure and the one-line verdict on cost versus the OIG offset. Below, 'Estimated effects' as a ruled table (CVEs per month, share of capacity, cost low/mid/high, offset). 'Basis of estimate' as short paragraphs. Citation and brief download in the header.
options.risk: Familiar: this is the document a policy audience trusts, and it looks like every other government PDF turned into a web page.

options.label: Well-Traveled Passport
options.lineage: passport data page, visa plates, and accumulated entry stamps
options.thesis: The NVD's weekly record as a stamped booklet: a machine-readable data page for this week's figures, and every past week landing as a dated stamp that never moves.
options.viewport: An open spread: left, the data page with the week's figures in OCR-B lines (22.6% CPE, 14-day KEV lag, $270K–$510K); right, a page of dated stamps, one per weekly pull, the newest still wet.
options.case: Fuses well: an official document everyone owns, with permalinked, printable weekly stamps that make the record portable. Loses on clarity: a staffer with two minutes has to find this week's number among stamps.
options.risk: Stamps accumulate into decoration if each one does not carry its figure legibly.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet Screen
options.lineage: 240-line arcade CRT with scanlines and phosphor bloom
options.thesis: The scorecard as a high-score screen: pixel caps pinned to the top edge, the coverage figure as the score.
options.viewport: A black screen with '22.6%' in eight-by-eight pixel caps and a blinking 'INSERT COIN'.
options.case: Game nostalgia has no purchase with policy staff, and a score screen trivialises a warning system.
options.kept: Strict palette law: a fixed, published state vocabulary.

options.label: Collider Event Display
options.thesis: One CVE held as one event: tracks curving outward through NVD, KEV, and EPSS rings, energy bars stacking in the calorimeter.
options.viewport: A concentric cross-section with PHP2Shell's timeline as tracks and the coverage figure pinned to a wedge.
options.case: Beautiful for the PHP2Shell worked example, but the audience is not physicists and the headline number has no home in a ring section.
options.kept: Confidence written as line weight: uncertain figures carry lighter rules.
options.risk: Reads as a science museum, not a policy page.

options.label: Sleeping City Fold
options.thesis: Districts of the CVE population folding under one night, each dreaming its own enrichment weather.
options.viewport: A folded city map with the coverage figure stitched along a seam.
options.case: A metaphor the reader must decode before any number is readable; nothing in it belongs to a hearing room.
options.kept: A static plate behind every animation, so motion never carries meaning alone.
options.risk: Reads as an illustration, not evidence.

options.label: Versailles Vistas
options.lineage: the gardens of Versailles: axial vistas, parterres, hidden bosquets
options.thesis: The four sections as an axial walk from the headline vista down to the labor beneath the fountains.
options.viewport: A terrace view down one axis with the coverage figure engraved at the vanishing point.
options.case: Grandeur is the wrong register for a disclosure, and engraved capitals fight tabular figures.
options.kept: The labor beneath the spectacle: every cost shows the hours behind it.

options.label: City-Pop Airbrush Sleeve
options.thesis: The scorecard as a coast-road sleeve: chrome script title over a sunset gradient, sections as stops along one horizon.
options.viewport: A gradient sky with 'NVD Watch' in chrome script and the figure floating above the horizon.
options.case: Nothing a congressional reader identifies with, and a pastel gradient under a 22.6% figure undercuts its seriousness.
options.kept: One horizon line: a single shared axis across every section.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A policy data dashboard: white ground, navy accent, four KPI tiles, a line chart, sticky section nav, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A headline, four stat tiles (coverage, KEV lag, cost, capacity), a chart, and a recommendations list below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every vulnerability-intelligence dashboard by design.
